units.source_text: 是年秋，源氏内大臣参拜住吉明神神社。

en.t: That autumn, Genji, the Inner Minister, paid a visit to the Sumiyoshi Myojin shrine.

units.source_text: 此行为了还愿，仪仗非常壮丽，举世盛传，轰动一时。

en.t: This visit was made to fulfill a vow, and his procession was so magnificent that word of it spread everywhere and caused a great stir.

units.source_text: 满朝公卿及殿上人争先参加。

en.t: The nobles and courtiers of the whole court vied with one another to take part.

units.source_text: 正在此时，明石姬也赴神社参拜。

en.t: Just at this time, the Akashi Lady also went to worship at the shrine.

units.source_text: 她向来每年去参拜一次。

en.t: She had always gone there once each year to pay her devotions.

units.source_text: 去年为了怀孕，今年为了生育，都不曾去，现在便将两次并作一次。

en.t: Because of her pregnancy last year and her childbirth this year, she had been unable to go, so now she meant to make one visit serve for both.

units.source_text: 她是乘船去的。

en.t: She went by boat.

units.source_text: 船靠岸时，但见岸上异常热闹，

en.t: When the boat drew up to the shore, she saw that the bank was extraordinarily lively,

units.source_text: 挤满了参拜的人，珍贵的供品络绎不绝地运来。

en.t: crowded with worshippers, while precious offerings were being brought in without end.

units.source_text: 乐人和十个舞手的装束非常华丽，而且一概选用相貌漂亮的人。

en.t: The musicians and the ten dancers were dressed with great splendor, and every one of them had been chosen for their handsome appearance.

units.source_text: 明石姬船上的人向岸上人问讯：“请问，是谁来参拜？”

en.t: Someone from the Akashi Lady's boat called to a person on shore, "May I ask who has come to worship?"

units.source_text: 岸上人答道：“源氏内大臣来还愿！

en.t: The person on shore replied, "The Inner Minister Genji has come to fulfill a vow!

units.source_text: 世间竟还有不知道的人呢。”

en.t: To think there is still someone in the world who does not know that."

units.source_text: 说罢，连那些身份极低的仆从也都得意扬扬地笑起来。

en.t: With that, even the lowliest servants burst out laughing in smug delight.

units.source_text: 明石姬想道：“真不凑巧，偏偏拣这个时候来！

en.t: The Akashi Lady thought, "How unlucky, to have chosen this very moment to come!

units.source_text: 教我遥望他的风姿，愈加显得我身世不幸了。

en.t: To look on his splendid figure from afar only makes my unhappy lot seem all the more wretched.

units.source_text: 我和他毕竟已结不解之缘。

en.t: After all, he and I are bound by a tie that cannot be undone.

units.source_text: 连那些下贱之人都得兴高采烈地追随左右，得意扬扬。

en.t: Even those lowly people may follow happily at his side, full of pride.

units.source_text: 只有我这个人，不知前世作了多少孽，一向关心他的行动，而偏偏不知道今天这件大事，贸然地来到此地。”

en.t: Only I, perhaps because of countless sins in a former life, care always about his doings, yet knew nothing of today's great occasion and came here so rashly."

units.source_text: 想到这里，十分悲伤，偷偷地流下泪来。

en.t: Thinking this, she became deeply sorrowful and secretly shed tears.
